title: At-Home Membership
source_quote: At-Home Membership $125/month Perfect for those who work primarily at home, this membership allows you access to our glazes and firings.
evidence_sentence: Members have access to soda firings once a soda firing 101 class has been taken.
evidence_quote: Open studio members have access to soda firings once a soda firing 101 class has been taken
how_to_join: Email featsofclayatx@gmail.com; there may be a waitlist. Requires taking two 6-week or longer courses within a calendar year.
summary: Home-based membership providing access to glazes and firings, including soda firing after completing a soda firing 101 class.
